name: image-generation-loader
title: Image Generation Loader
description: A square placeholder that animates while an image is generated: 12 CSS styles (skeleton, scan, pixel grid, resolution, coalesce, diffusion, shutter and more).
author: Kasturi Khanke <https://github.com/kasturibuilds>
docs:
Installed `ImageGenerationLoader` (`@/components/ui/image-generation-loader`), with its CSS keyframes inside the file (React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once).

```tsx
import { ImageGenerationLoader } from "@/components/ui/image-generation-loader";

<ImageGenerationLoader variant="pixel-grid" size={240} />
```

Render it where the image will appear, at the image's size, and swap in the image when it arrives. It draws in `currentColor`; `label` sets what screen readers announce. Motion stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Ported from generative-loaders (`ImageLoader`) by Kasturi Khanke (MIT); the license notice is at the end of the file.
